notes.title: Free Camera Mode Alpha
notes.content:
Per request, we’ve added in a basic Free Camera Mode to Wave Break that will allow players to capture custom footage. As it is still very basic and rudimentary, we will look into making improvements based on feedback from our community as we move forward.

[h1]How to Access Free Camera Mode[/h1]
[h2]Entering Chat[/h2]
[olist]
[*] Boot the game.
[*] Select and start any game mode.
[*] Once in the game mode, press ‘Enter’ on the keyboard to access Chat.
[*] Once in Chat, you can type in specific commands.
[/olist]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34089288/4ac980db57525f3fdf62b4e45f745e8d3f29c8fa.jpg[/img]
[h1]Basic Commands[/h1]
[h2]Turn Off UI[/h2]
[olist]
[*] Access Chat in game.
[*] In Chat, type in: [b]/toggle_ui
[/b][*] To turn UI back on, press ‘Enter’ to access Chat, then type in: [b]/toggle_ui[/b]
[/olist]
[h2]Spectator Mode[/h2]
[olist]
[*] Access Chat in game.
[*] In Chat, type in: [b]/toggle_spectate[/b]; if done correctly, you’ll spawn as Bigpin (the bear)
[*] Pause the game and select ‘End Run.’
[*] Start the game again; you will now start in free cam, and can move the camera using the left analog stick, and pan the camera with the right analog stick.
[*] To turn off Spectator Mode, press ‘Enter’ to access Chat, then type in: [b]/toggle_spectate[/b]
[/olist]
[h2]Freeze Camera Position[/h2]
[olist]
[*] Access Chat in game
[*] In Chat, type in: [b]/freeze_camera_position[/b]; if done correctly, the camera will now be in the fixed position, and will remain that position until it is disabled.
[*] To turn off Freeze Camera Position, press ‘Enter’ to access Chat, then type in: [b]/freeze_camera_position[/b]
[/olist]
[h2]Freeze Camera Rotation[/h2]
[olist]
[*] Access Chat in game.
[*] In Chat, type in: [b]/freeze_camera_rotation[/b]; if done correctly, you will be unable to change the camera rotation/panning.
[*] To turn off Freeze Camera Rotation, press ‘Enter’ to access Chat, then type in: [b]/freeze_camera_rotation[/b]
[/olist]
[h1]Multiple Displays[/h1]
[olist]
[*] If you have a multiple display setup, first go to the ‘Options’ Menu, and on the first tab for ‘Graphics,’ select ‘Multiple Display Splitscreen.’
[*] In the Main Menu, have a second player join in (local co-op).
[*] Start any game mode, then access Chat.
[*] You’ll find that Display 1 or Player 1 will be able to input commands into the Chat, and it will directly affect Display 2 or Player 2; you can use Player 2 as a means to capture the specific footage you like, with Player 1 accessing the commands.
[/olist]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34089288/c3795646886b100a265b463cdfad529f55cec501.jpg[/img]

We'd appreciate any feedback with this new feature, and additionally, if you encounter any issues or bugs, please feel free to join our Discord and let us know!
[url=Discord.gg/FunktronicLabs][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34089288/1385557c7916d7f3ecb704e119168264fe4303e3.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Major Update | Steam Deck Verified, New Character, Cosmetics & Event!
notes.content:
[h2]Hey Everyone![/h2]

[h3]First off, Wave Break is officially Steam Deck Verified! [/h3]

The Steam Deck is now officially supported with a native Linux build! (Some UI will be automatically scaled up for the smaller screen) 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34089288/8fc5157f61f75fb60f037a4e57de606976924ce5.png[/img]

[h3]But that's not all...remember the flamingo from the launch trailer?[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34089288/7e80167654ca94a37f871558896b496256590931.gif[/img]

[h3]We've added her in as a playable character![/h3] 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34089288/a8f6a7c392fbfdcaf6c3ce83060ec592c497eac8.png[/img]
[h3]Here are the additional changes we've made to the game:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Added new cosmetic items!
[*]Changed the menu text for "Online Lobbies" to "Custom Games" to make it more clear.
[*]Fix for semi transparent Park Creator previews for non stroke items on Vulkan.
[*]Made the first COMBO mission in the game a bit easier to complete on the initial lower stats.
[*]Updated internal Steamworks.NET
[*]The Tutorial now requests that you do some of the steps 3 times, in an effort to help people remember the controls better.
[*]The Tutorial now has an additional step of completing a single 1,000 point combo.
[*]Lowered the Campaign "Next Level" requirement from 60% to 30%.
[*]The initial stats on Big Pin have been upped by 2 or 3 per stat (mostly Grind and Automatic balance).
[*]Rescheduled all events to end at midnight PST instead of UTC.
[*]Events now show the final results the second the event is over, instead of the following day.
[/list]
[h3]Don't forget, 🎧HEADPHONES🎧 vs. 🔊SPEAKERS🔊 starts today![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34089288/21d5c8b340770cd3085656c066be850c7f49ba69.gif[/img]

Test your skills in this month's in-game event! Play a round of Time Attack on the special event level, for a chance to win some sweet prizes! For more information, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/761010/view/3173359579462955773]visit our previous Steam post for more details[/url]!

[url=https://discord.gg/funktroniclabs][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34089288/1385557c7916d7f3ecb704e119168264fe4303e3.png[/img][/url]

As usual, you can always find us on [url=discord.gg/funktroniclabs]Discord[/url] if you have any questions, suggestions, or just are looking for others to play the game with.

[h3]Good luck to everyone participating in the event!  See you out there![/h3]
~Funktronic Labs Dev Team

notes.title: Major Update | Signal Tools, Teams, New Cosmetics
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34089288/0f40366a2ab6868b8757e20a76f17a7e56cd1a30.png[/img]
We’re prioritizing fixes and adding features based on fan feedback, and we thank all of you who have been active on our Discord for helping to pave the way for these updates. This update will serve as a foundation for future upcoming updates, where we are introducing Team Based Game Modes, a new Signaling System, 18 new cosmetic items, new Park Creator pieces, and general quality of life bug fixes and optimization.

[h3]
Team Based Game Modes[/h3]

With Team Based Game Modes, players will now be able to team up with their friends and other SkateBOATERS in 4 vs 4 matches in Time Attack and Deathmatch. In Team Time Attack, the total overall score from each team member will be tabulated, and the team with the highest score will win the match.  For Team Deathmatch, the team with the most kills will win the match.

Team based game modes allow for some interesting strategies not available in regular competitive multiplayer.  For example, players who are more adept to the tricking mechanic can focus on raising the overall score in Team Time Attack, while other team members concentrate on disrupting the opponents trick combos by shooting at them.  


[h3]The Signaling System 
[/h3]

Brand new to the Park Creator, which will allow for deeper customization, more complex level designs, and different gameplay elements, is the Signaling System. If you’re familiar with WireMod, or Redstone in Minecraft, these features will be easy to pick up and implement. You can find out more about the Signaling System in detail in our Signal System Post we posted up earlier this week. 

https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/761010/view/2939150188529175921


[h3]New Park Creator Pieces[/h3]

Below are some new Park Creator pieces we’ve added into the game; most of these pieces pertain the to Signaling System we’ve newly created:
[list]
[*] Signal Sources: pulse, alternators, constants, randoms
[*] Signal Wires
[*] Signal Triggers: laser tripwire, button, lever, damage target, physics trigger (player only), physics trigger (anything)
[*] Logic Gates: AND, OR, NAND, XOR, NOT, DELAY, EXTEND, BUFFER, SWITCH, PULSE
[*] Dynamic Park Piece markers: enabler, movers
[*] Pickups: chickens, hotdogs
[*] Custom game functions: +1 point to nearest player, end run
[*] Prop Spawners: beach balls, buoys, chairs, trash cans
[*] Particle Spawners
[*] Death Zones
[*] Lights
[*] Speakers
[*] Teleporters
[*] Jump Pads
[/list]

[h3]
New Cosmetics Added into the Loot Pool[/h3]

We’ve added 18 new cosmetic items that can be acquired in-game at Big Beavy’s Boats and Beach Boutique shops to customize your character when taking on other skateBOATERS.


[h3]Upcoming Updates[/h3]

We have two more major updates this year, and our hope is to have a roadmap prepared by the next update that will show what you can look forward to in the upcoming months. 

[url=discord.gg/FunktronicLabs]Please keep sharing your feed back here, and in discord!  [/url]
Without you, we wouldn't have been able to do any of these things!

See you soon!

-Kyle

notes.title: Wave Break Major Update: The Signal System
notes.content:
In this upcoming update, we will be introducing the Signal System into the Park Creator game mode.
These tools will allow for deeper customization, more complex level designs, and you can even add your own game play element!

[h3][b]Essentially, we're making the buttons work, and we're letting YOU choose what to do with them![/b][/h3]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34089288/d822006f05b82d41e977bf40c8ded0317a0ebd30.gif[/img]

If you're familiar with WireMod (Garry's Mod) or Minecraft's RedStone, these tools will be easy for you to pick up and use!



The DEV preview we put out has a high level overview of the tools added, but for now, here's a quick overview of the new tools.


[h2]The Signal Tools[/h2]

[list]
[*] [b]Source Blocks [/b]- Signal Source Blocks create a signal. Timers, pulses, constants are blocks that will send a signal in a variety of ways. 

[*] [b]Wires[/b] - Used to transfer signals. 
[i][b]note: We've added the ability to wire up MOST park pieces that were already part of the park creator...try  it out with some explosives or speed boost decals![/b][/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34089288/631535fb76ff1ce7524b60643172791cf30e7d5a.gif[/img]

[*] [b]Logic Gates[/b] - Logic Blocks allow you to alter the signal being sent before it reaches its target. Logic Blocks take two inputs and have an output depending on the state of the inputs. Logic Blocks touching other Logic Blocks do not need a wire.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34089288/aa780d0a5ddfc7606882aabe82475f79b7c53b25.gif[/img]

[*] [b]Triggers[/b] - Connect triggers to any of the interactive objects, and it will send a signal anytime the action happens. Triggers include tripwires, buttons, levers and toggle switches.


[*] [b]Dynamic Park Pieces[/b] - Create moving platforms at 1, 2, or 4 times speed using the same placement system as our custom rail & ramp tools. Enablers, which can turn entire park pieces off and on.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34089288/50ef47820236b1c5fc4e1a5bf0b6cbec0cca03a2.gif[/img]

[*] [b]Particle Emitters[/b] - When activated, these will emit particles; we’ve given you a few of the in-game particles to select from

[*] [b]Speakers [/b]- Connect a speaker to any of the in-game buttons or triggers and have it play one of  the selected in-game sound effects

[*] [b]Pick ups[/b] - A selection of objects for you to place throughout your level,  When picked up, they output a signal.

[*] [b]Lights[/b] - Connect in-game objects to any in-game light and have it light up, or turn off (with the use of Logic Blocks)

[*] [b]Teleporters[/b] - Create two different locations, and teleport between them

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34089288/ba850a3db7f4961a54956a8b2bd5a11bdd5e463b.gif[/img]

[*][b] Custom Game Functions[/b]  - we’re excited about these ones…. These pieces are very specific in nature, one, when activated, will give the player that activates it points.  The other will end the round. 
[/list]


[h3]These features will release on PC Wednesday, September 15th. [/h3]


This developer preview gives a brief showcase of the new Signal Tools, as well as a small example wiring some triggers to lights!
[previewyoutube=QtGQ7CQ92Bg;full][previewyoutube=Y_luq8a3tEU;full][/previewyoutube][/previewyoutube]


Join the discord to stay updated on Wave Break news FIRST
[url=Discord.gg\FunktronicLabs][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34089288/1385557c7916d7f3ecb704e119168264fe4303e3.png[/img][/url]



That's all for now, we'll have more information on Team Based Gamemodes SOON™

-Kyle

Speakers - Connect a speaker to any of the in-game buttons or triggers and have it play one of the selected in-game sound effects
Pick ups - A selection of objects for you to place throughout your level, When picked up, they output a signal.
Lights - Connect in-game objects to any in-game light and have it light up, or turn off (with the use of Logic Blocks)
Teleporters - Create two different locations, and teleport between them
Custom Game Functions - we’re excited about these ones…. These pieces are very specific in nature, one, when activated, will give the player that activates it points. The other will end the round.

notes.title: Fixes for Leaderboard & Various Physics\UI bugs
notes.content:
[h3]Major changes:[/h3]
 - fixes for steam leaderboard shenanigans + there is no longer a weekly variant + uploads are now queued such that they don't exceed steam's rate limits + if the queued uploads don't finish before the game is closed, they are saved and finished next time the game is ran
- steam leaderboards now track the character and boat you are using, as well as attach a timestamp for when you submitted your score.
 - bails now block input in more areas of the player controller
 - leaderboard uploads are now queued internally, such that they won't ever go over the steam rate limit (10 uploads per 10 minutes); so data does not get lost
 - fix for pause button not unpausing as well
 - tweaks to automatics/half pipes, you get a bit more air + some fixes for jumping at strange angles or velocities 

[h3]Everything else:[/h3]

 - don't wait on player config before sending park data
 - fix for ghost CPUs appearing in the park creator when the host is testing
 - fix for stacked env particles in level editor
 - favorting lobbies no longer gets the ui in a weird state
 - mirror mode visuals now on the comment layer; so that they are not visible in-game
 - can no longer drive up walls in the ice level + some physics performance improvements in the ice level
 - when pressing A/X/space to unpause; the game will now wait for the button release before unpausing, to prevent accidental jumps
 - caught and fixed another grind rail erroneous trick landing

notes.title: Wave Break Update: Leaderboards, Server Browsers, Flipoff 2021 Event
notes.content:
[h3]MAJOR CHANGES:[/h3]

  - Added Flipoff 2021 Event   
  - Added a lobby(Beta) system to replace matchmaking 
  - Added leaderboards 
  - Added global chat 

[h3]ALL CHANGES:[/h3]
 
 - score calculation trick mult curve has been nerfed; trying to prevent integer overflow size combos
 - ready/go timing for controls being locked is correct now
 - fix for sometimes landing combos when jumping off of a grind rail
 - instant feedback when going to main menu from game modes
 - don't wait for disconnect to unpause
 - no longer give points for killing NPCs in deathmatch
 - don't spawn boats for killed spectators
 - fix for spectators going to main menu soft locking
 - npcs do a raycast before shooting now, hopefully no longer shooting thru walls 
 - can no longer accidentally undo/redo when typing in chat in park creator
 - numpad 9 will no longer toggle to spectator cam
 - always send a completed message for park downloads 
 - fix for soft lock in park creator non lobby with multiple clients joining
 - blocking a user via steam now also blocks their global chat messages
 - fix for toggling a game mode causing issues
 - grinding and jumping will no longer randomly land tricks
 - fix for a long standing bug - trick timing was stricter on land than water
 - fixed box corner color tint
 - tweaked camera placement and fixed the lerp thing on start with registered parks
 - created a park (coty+kat) for the 2021 flipoff event
 - re-lightbake for ice
 - fix for waterfall particle sometimes (rarely) getting stuck to the boat (due to addressables stuff)
 - added a min purchase date; to fix issue with private profiles getting all the gifts
 - added command to get invite urls (steam only)
 - hotfix for rewired not having correct focus state on startup
 - fix for connecting to client as host from steam friends list
 - quest complete stroke looks nicer on ultra wide displays now
 - fix for guns vanishing after cutscenes when retrying missions
 - the shield can now be rebound in the advanced input menu
 - added game option for disabling dynamic lightbar support for ds4/ds5 controllers
 - fix for wrong color nametags and fix for dedicated server CPUs not showing online
 - check whats in the lobby before joining
 - fix for player sometimes (rarely) clipping thru the half pipes when getting attached
 - fix for options clearing some decals until scene restart
 - improved reverts; especially when coming down half pipes backwards
 - fix for localization of party member dropdown
 - pressing pause will escape tool
 - added a notification system for chatboxes
 - clients mirror cursor being active also synced
 - update the visuals for the mirror'd cursor for online players in the park creator
 - do not allow alt rotation when mirror mode is enabled
 - static net-id rebake for all levels
 - fix for network IDs of objects randomly shuffling every single build (so we can build for dedicated server linux/windows and not have id mismatch)
 - ALL grind rails in the park creator will now redirect instead of bail / clip
 - grabs are now stricter; you cant spam circle to grab spam anymore, and you must leave 0.2s for most grabs before you can land them
 - fix for friends filter not working + using the format stuff to censor and add hyperlinks to names in the leaderboards
 - can now click on a players name in the chat to open their steam profile
 - when doing console commands; they now appear in the chat you typed them in
 - global chat can now be disabled via the options menu (hides the whole tab)
 - revamped chat window, now has tabs
 - global chat messages now have a [Global] prefix
 - global chat count players command added
 - added alternate grind spot for double pool grind mission
 - less likely for players to fall thru water
 - big improvement to move gizmo in park creator using mouse
 - no longer resetting options on version updates!
 - fix for terrain being wrong in main menu
 - fix for water height and park pieces being incorrectly aligned in the main menu (requires a scene change!)
 - performance fix for grind rails from level editor (huge perf boost to weezer stage)
 - face wear can now be found in the shops
 - changed [dev] tag to [Funk] tag
 - added the ability for developer accounts to give items to players connected to them
 - added Kyle to credits (it was an accident we promise)
 - fix for chat being under create lobby menu
 - browse error handling + prefab fixes
 - proper callbacks for create/joins so its platform agnostic ui stuff
 - fixed misaligned ui elements
 - some fixes for headless dedicated servers
 - fixed missing rank on scoreboard entry
 - impatience is now rewarded greatly
 - overlay enabled
 - ui tweaks
 - create lobby ui fix
 - added the event stuff + more leaderboard shenanigans
 - leaderboard ui tweaks
 - hid the hide ui button in results menu
 - completely hide the leaderboard button on platforms that do not support it; and for ones that do just gray it out when not available
 - fix for not being able to go down in selection from date range select
 - modified leaderboard keys
 - if metadata not supported on platform, just default to opening their profile
 - hide leaderboard button when not supported
 - refactored some leaderboard stuff, improved details page greatly, added monthly leaderboards, and added date type selection
 - replaced placeholder pfx for canyon targets
 - details view of a leaderboard entry is now very fancy
 - added flamingo bail recovery sprites
 - lots of cleanup + fix for metadata not displaying + started a mini framework for metadata
 - (lobbies) fix for toggling park creator not refreshing selectables
 - "still going" state is now synced
 - tab/end scoreboards now never show the disconnected players
 - fix for incorrect auth status for dropin
 - dedicated server now handles disconencting from steam while running... should reconnect too
 - fixed for host leaving leaving clients in a weird state in lobbies (they think they are lobby hosts but there is no lobby)
 - clients now know about the authenticated state of other clients
 - added a rematch counter
 - dedicated server code now works in the new lobby system (included a new DedicatedServerConfig.json too)
 - fix for being soft locked into the custom shape menu in park creator if you bind back to ESC
 - reclaim ownership of rigidbodies marked by other players
 - dont sync all kinematic stuff all the time (now its problematic after the switch port; due to the kinematic freeze from fluid sim)
 - fix for joining from right click when already in lobby
 - fix for right click -> join
 - (most) inputfields are now clickable with controller on pc
 - redirect at connect not at rich pres invite
 - fix for multiple players in the score ui if they reconnect over and over (disconnect message was not sent)
 - allow this kind of join + some logging
 - changes to score panel
 - black screen fix for weird timed disconnect
 - fix for lobby host not waiting for 2nd+ loads
 - players were in the wrong field
 - redirect and lobby join now keeps note if a password is necessary
 - right click -> join from friends list for existing lobby
 - show more, and pressing back goes to the same lobby
 - when right clicking to join a lobby player; allow redirecting the client into the lobby
 - try to better handle parties going into lobbies and creating lobbies
 - server now enforces slot count set for lobby
 - dont wait on non authenticated players for still going check
 - pressing return on keyboard will auto submit password for lobby
 - allow lobby hosts to end runs anytime
 - lobby filter up/down
 - refresh button moved out of shortcut bar into the top filter menu
 - close chat if its blocked by input field after it was opened
 - stop counting down if leaving a lobby in the end of match screen
 - fix for not disbanding party on going back to main menu
 - some more authentication requirements throughout the game on password stuff
 - leave lobby when going to main menu (server)
 - better handling for clients getting themselves in trouble
 - dont auto scroll when selecting a toggle + removed rich text  from lobby browser names
 - the lobby browser now has a few filters + i removed CONTROL from being the default back button omg
 - load edge case fix
 - fix for infinite load for when a player joins while the host is in the transition load scene
 - MUCH better inputfield behavior



Questions, comments, wanna just bother the devs?

Hop into our discord!
[url=discord.gg/FunktronicLabs][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34089288/63c6009081453b8b28c4fc1fbbb1ac52883bba58.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: PAX West Playtest Session 8/30 - 9/2
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34089288/4449255e0f32b43ffa957b28b40887b5a496a3af.png[/img]

[i]Hello, Waterboating Connoisseurs![/i]

This week we're heading to PAX West to showcase Wave Break, and we'll be hosting a large playtest throughout the entire weekend of PAX! You can get a key from the Discord channel, and play as much as you like throughout the duration of the playtest.

[u][b]PAX West Alpha Multiplayer Playtest[/b][/u]
August 30th, 10AM (PST) - September 2nd, 5PM (PST)

[b]Playtest Game Modes[/b]
[list]
[*] Time Attack
[*] Deathmatch
[*] Turf War 
[/list]
[b]Alpha Steam Keys[/b]
[list]
[*] discord.gg/funktroniclabs
[/list]
We have made some big changes since our last playtest!  We’ve refined the core controls, rebalanced the scoring and driving mechanics, and added tons of new stuff into the levels.  Along with vastly improved water visuals and physics, you now get an extra combo multiplier when you kill another player. You can now freely jump in and out of your boat - or steal one from another player!

Thanks to the many helpful reports from our previous playtesters, we’ve been able to fix bugs and improve performance.  If you see something, say something!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34089288/51577e0728c9e5b03fcfcd232e5ccc0e22734e8f.png[/img]

[u][b]Show us your Insane Trick Combos[/b][/u]
Post your best trick combos on Twitter and tag us at [url=https://twitter.com/WaveBreakGame]@WaveBreakGame[/url] with the hashtag #WaveBreakCombo.

We'll pick the best combo winner for a PAX West Prize Pack which includes:
[list]
[*] Exclusive Wave Break shirt
[*] Enamel Pins set
[/list]
We'll be posting updates on [url=https://twitter.com/WaveBreakGame]Twitter[/url] throughout the week, and ping us on Discord if you have any questions or feedback!

🌊Team Wave Break🌊
